final_report: The patient experienced rapid succession of severe adverse events: Grade 3 anaphylaxis, Grade 4 neutropenia (days 15-28), and fatal pneumonia (Grade 5 on day 99). Grade 4 neutropenia indicates profound bone marrow suppression, increasing infection risk. Fatal pneumonia reflects systemic decompensation. ECOG 1 suggests functional limitation. Cumulative Grade 3+ events indicate high frailty and poor prognosis.
